requests.subject: draft_prospect
requests.words: Separately, for the 2006 offseason, I would like the scouting department to keep Kyle Lowry of Villanova and P.J. Tucker of Texas under consideration. These are recommendations for evaluation, not demands for roster transactions.
requests.note: Scouting recommendation: watch his perimeter defense, playmaking, competitiveness and development as a lead guard. On the date he is a Villanova sophomore; whether he enters the 2006 draft and where he ranks are decided by the simulation's draft-night evidence. Weighed only on Miami's own 2006 picks (runtime/draft.py); never a demand.

requests.note: Wade asks Miami to draft P.J. Tucker in the 2006 draft, more than the evaluation he asked for on 2005-10-31; this row replaces that one (the latest row per prospect stands; Kyle Lowry's evaluate request is unchanged). Weighed on Miami's own 2006 picks only (on the date it holds only its 2006 second-round pick), never another club's and never in a trade (runtime/draft.py rule 7): available in the best available tier at Miami's pick, he is always a candidate with the evaluate lift and an engine draw first takes him at Wade's request with chance standing weight x closeness (his draw weight against the club favourite's); outside that tier the request opposes tier dominance and is an engine-drawn decision at standing weight x closeness (one less his distance below the tier's line in tier widths; a whole tier below is a clear-cut call that cannot be moved). Never a certainty. Whether he enters the 2006 draft and where he ranks are decided by the simulation's draft-night evidence.
